purpose: Freeze contemporaneous expectation burden using research available before each event-time cutoff. Research is expectation validation only, never discovery.

cases.name: 招商南油

sources.claim: Industry supply-demand improvement and MR freight-rate earnings sensitivity were already well understood before Q1 results; company rated Buy.
Q1 profit of about RMB0.41bn was described as in line with expectations; 2023-2025 net profit forecasts RMB1.7/2.1/2.1bn, corresponding to about 11x/9x/9x PE.

cases.rationale: The tanker upcycle and company freight-rate sensitivity were not hidden. The fresh hub information is China's extreme diesel-export flow, while Q1 company earnings largely confirm a cycle the market already followed. Low valuation and severe price underperformance create room, but fresh incrementality is weaker than the headline growth rate suggests.

cases.name: 招商轮船

sources.claim: Target price RMB9.10 versus Aug-28 close RMB6.18; company rated Buy.
2023-2025 profit forecasts RMB6.23/8.72/10.74bn, corresponding to about 8x/6x/5x PE; target RMB10.22, about 65% above contemporaneous price. Ro-ro H1 net profit RMB126m, +1304.8%.

cases.rationale: The consolidated company was inexpensive and analyst upside remained large. Ro-ro growth was discussed in research, so it was not secret, but the fast-growing profit pool remained a minority segment within a diversified shipping group and price absorption was only modest at the cutoff.

cases.name: 白云机场

sources.claim: 2023E net profit RMB649m, implied PE about 57.8x; international-flight recovery and duty-free recovery were already explicit parts of the investment case.

cases.rationale: The hub adds a useful structural insight—traffic recovered faster than spending—but the airport reopening and international-traffic recovery were already heavily expected and valued at a high forward multiple.

cases.name: 华能国际

sources.claim: Q1 earnings improvement was already recognized as realized; lower coal cost and expected Q2 power-demand recovery were central to the thesis.
May-12 price RMB9.86, target RMB11.90; 3-month absolute share-price gain already about 21.3%, showing meaningful expectation absorption before the late-June coal-price reset.

cases.rationale: Thermal-power margin recovery was already consensus by May. The incremental question at end-June is whether the much larger-than-expected coal-price decline created a fresh magnitude reset sufficient to overcome prior rerating.
